name: Maejima Takahiro
source:
A gloomy boy who is the protagonist of this game. Because he tends to daydream and being absentminded most of the time, he looks like a depressive person from the outside.

He is not good at socializing and although he's not particularly bullied, he has no friends.
He likes Yanamoto Yuki, a popular and outgoing girl from the same class, but he doesn't have the courage to speak to her.
